summary: stat retrieves file metadata like the Unix stat command; Windows uses win_stat.
questions: How do I check if a file exists with Ansible?
How do I get a file's permissions or owner?
How do I stat files on Windows?

answer_card.title: Get file info with stat
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.stat` returns file facts like `stat`: existence, owner, mode, type, checksum, etc. Windows: `ansible.windows.win_stat`.
